recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14057 in core unless a future CQI decision changes the broader Measure subject model; related later changes should continue to be handled under their own issue keys.
issue_request: FHIR-14057 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CQI change request asking to generalize MeasureReport from patient-only reporting to a subject model. The resolution required changing patient to subject, allowing MeasureReport.subject to reference Patient plus Group, Location, Organization, RelatedPerson, Device, and Practitioner, updating $evaluate-measure to use a subject parameter, and adding the analogous Measure subject type indication.
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied at SVN 12641. In git, 734c7befc75fc6677ab2dbae8d77bdc07428cc5b is the matching application commit and explicitly says it generalized patient to subject in Measure and MeasureReport. That historical commit changed the then-current Measure and MeasureReport spreadsheets, examples, and $evaluate-measure request text.
additional_context: Measure and MeasureReport are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. The current source has MeasureReport.subject rather than MeasureReport.patient, its target profiles include every resource type required by FHIR-14057 and later additions, Measure.subject[x] and Measure.group.subject[x] carry the generalized subject model, and the Measure operations list includes both the current $evaluate operation and retired $evaluate-measure operation. Later related decisions already represented on the combined branch refined the same area: FHIR-21299 audited Measure/MeasureReport subject alignment, FHIR-17355 aligned Group membership wording, FHIR-40422 completed group-level Measure subject support, and FHIR-16822 fixed remaining generic patient-only wording.
reconciliation: This reconciliation intentionally made no source change. The current authoritative source already satisfies the seed request: MeasureReport has a generalized subject element, $evaluate-measure has a subject input parameter, and Measure indicates subject type. Remaining patient wording found in examples and patient-specific search parameters is either an explicit Patient example or a Patient-scoped search parameter over MeasureReport.subject, not a stale patient-only resource model.
